title: QODIQA Local Artifact & Transparency-Proof Verification Conformance Vectors
description: Schema for test-vectors/artifact-v1.json. Every SDK implementation (present and future) consumes vectors matching this schema without any language-specific transformation of the file itself. See test-vectors/README-artifact.md for the full contract.

protocolVersion.description: Artifact/transparency verification protocol version these vectors describe. Bump this (and the filename, e.g. artifact-v2.json) if the wire protocol ever intentionally changes.

serverImplementation.description: The production module(s) whose output is captured in this file.

artifactVector.description: One case for the local artifact verifier (ArtifactVerifier.verify() / verify_artifact()).

id.description: Unique, stable, kebab-case identifier. Do not reuse or repurpose an id once published — add a new vector instead.

artifact.description: The exact object to pass to verify(). May be structurally malformed for negative vectors — pass it through unmodified, do not coerce types.

keySet.description: Trust bundle to configure the artifact-key provider (StaticKeyProvider) with for this vector.

verifyAt.description: Unix ms epoch to pass as the verifier's `_now` override.

transparencyProof.description: Reserved for future combined artifact+proof vectors; currently always null.

expected.description: Subset of ArtifactVerificationResult fields to assert (camelCase field names; map to each SDK's own naming convention). Fields not present are not asserted by the conformance suite.

transparencyVector.description: One case for the local transparency-proof verifier.

proof.description: The TransparencyInclusionProof wire object to verify, or null for the 'no proof supplied' case.

transparencyKeySet.description: Trust bundle to configure the transparency-key provider with — a separate trust domain from artifactVectors[].keySet.

expected.description: Subset of TransparencyVerificationDetail fields plus transparencyVerified to assert. When `proof` is null, only transparencyVerified is meaningful.
